library_name: AD5X Design — Small Physical Panel Components (Starter)
purpose: Exact, user-selected workshop components for panel/enclosure/jig openings; NOT PCB footprints.

policy.mains_power_warning: A 3D printed panel fit test does not establish electrical safety, enclosure certification, insulation, heat/fire performance, or conformity.

coordinate_convention: All cutouts centered at local XY origin. DXF units mm. Applied panel placement and orientation handled by consumer; D flat on left in local preview.

components.name: IEC C14 AC inlet with rocker switch

mounting_holes.notes: Only hole diameter and spacing are given; relative Y alignment/offset to cutout is not confirmed. Do NOT auto-cut mounting holes yet.

notes: Vendor calls this product generic. 42x27mm is the supplier-stated cutout, NOT the dimensions of every C14 inlet.
C14 DXF includes ONLY nominal rectangular aperture; no fixing holes.
Safety: accurate fit alone is not evidence of mains insulation, heat resistance, flame rating or regulatory compliance.
measurements_needed: Physical test fit for this exact SKU
Mounting-hole XY positions relative to cutout center
Clearance around terminals and wiring path

sources.supports: 42x27 panel opening; 3.5mm mounting holes; 50mm hole spacing; 27.5mm depth; max panel thickness 2mm

components.name: Sealed momentary pushbutton, black, Series 59
components.supplier: ITW Industrial Components (box label) / ITW Switches
notes: D-profile orientation in the supplied DXF is arbitrary; rotate to match the installed switch.
Panel seal relies on proper O-ring, surface quality and nut installation. 3D printing does not guarantee IP67.
DO NOT substitute a plain 13.6 mm round hole without an anti-rotation assessment.
measurements_needed: Physical fit test with button and supplied nut/O-ring
Printed hole tolerance and layer orientation

sources.supports: 13.6mm panel cutout, ITW SKU, SPST momentary

components.name: IEC C14 inlet, no rocker switch
notes: The exact SKU's supplier FRONT-VIEW drawing shows a 50 x 29 mm flange and two diameter 3.5 mm fixing holes spaced 40 mm symmetrically on the horizontal centreline.
The same front view labels inner outlines 29.3 x 21.7 mm and 23 x 15.8 mm, but DOES NOT identify a verified panel cutout. Neither outline is an approved cutter.
Not interchangeable with C14-SWITCH geometry. No DXF or automatic cutter until the behind-panel body silhouette and tolerances are verified.
measurements_needed: Correct through-panel aperture contour, not merely a projected front-view outline
Rear body clearance/shape including corner bevels or radius
Physical mounting and printable tolerance for this exact specimen

sources.supports: 33mm depth; 3.5mm fixing hole diameter; max 2mm panel thickness
Exact supplier front-view diagram: flange 50 x 29 mm; two symmetrically centred fixing holes 40 mm apart; inner drawing outlines are not labelled panel apertures

components.name: 3mm LED concave metal holder (10-pack)
notes: 3mm denotes the LED it accepts, NOT the panel cutout diameter.
The exact supplier page references a mechanical-diagram image, but its numerical contents were inaccessible during the 24 October 2026 verification.
A similarly styled LEDH-03-CONV or LEDH-03-BLK is a DIFFERENT SKU: its thread/hole dimensions must not be reused.
measurements_needed: Panel cutout diameter or thread specification

sources.supports: product/SKU identification and compatibility with 3mm LEDs

components.name: 3mm LED black plastic snap-in holder (10-pack)
notes: LED size is not the mounting-hole size.
The exact supplier listing identifies a black cylindrical plastic holder supplied in a pack of ten. It publishes no mounting-hole diameter or acceptable panel thickness.
Snap-in geometry and panel thickness must be determined for this exact holder; do not borrow dimensions from the metal LEDH holders.

sources.supports: 3mm LED compatibility; black cylindrical plastic snap-in panel holder

components.name: Panel fuse holder for 5x20mm cartridge fuse (4-pack)
notes: 5x20mm refers to the replaceable fuse, NOT the hole size.
The exact supplier category listing says the panel-mounted holder includes a mounting washer; the diameter, anti-rotation flats, and installation depth remain UNKNOWN.
Do not borrow mounting-hole dimensions from other 5x20mm fuse holders.

sources.supports: supplier listing of 5x20mm panel fuse holder, 10A, 250V (via search indexed listing)

components.name: 12V automotive accessory socket, female, with cap
notes: The supplier describes a capped, tethered, accessory-only DC power outlet with 20A maximum; the IP66 rating is supplier-advertised and unverified.
Seller warns that the item is not suitable for the heat of a cigarette lighter element.
No mounting hole dimensions verified. Do not infer a nominal cigar-lighter socket diameter or flats from competing parts.

sources.supports: 12V female socket, maximum 20A, capped, advertised IP66

components.name: 0.28-inch 2-wire DC digital voltmeter, red
notes: 0.28 inch is display size, NOT the panel cutout.
Supplier states approximately 500 ms refresh interval and -10 to 65 C ambient range; these are electrical/environment specifications, NOT mounting dimensions.
The exact product may be a bare module instead of an integrated snap-in panel insert; no 23x10 or 30x11.5 lookalike cutout is permitted.

sources.supports: seller page 0.28-inch, 2-wire red LED voltmeter, 2.5-30V DC
